evidence.snippet: The identified treatment modalities were the administration of corticosteroids and/or IVIG. An improvement was noted in 3 of the patients receiving only corticosteroids and in 3 of the patients receiving both steroids and IVIG.

nodes.description: Following entry, the flaviviral genome is translated and replicated and progeny virions disseminate, producing a peripheral viremic phase that precedes central nervous system invasion. In mouse studies, POWV RNA and antigen are detected within 24 hours in draining lymph nodes, blood, bite-site macrophages, and splenic macrophages, although at the bite site it remains uncertain whether antigen-positive phagocytes are productively infected or have engulfed viral particles.
